claude.performance_metric: JV survived as going concern; still launching new SLC NAND lines in 2021–2022; no financial scalar available (deregistered April 2020)
claude.rationale: The realized record shows the joint venture (SkyHigh Memory Limited) continued as an operating NAND supplier through the outcome window, expanding its ML-3 SLC NAND product family on 1xnm technology in October 2021 with sampling in early 2022 — no documented product/process incoherence, so p4_pathway = 0. The JV remained under its two parents' ownership as a going concern with no documented operations-vs-organization fracture, so p5_pathway = 0. Financial outcome scalars (net income, impairment, divestiture) are explicitly uncertain/unverified, but no disruption at either interface is documented, which under conservative coding is 0 (not-documented) rather than uncertain for the pathways.

grok.performance_metric: no divestiture; JV retained and still launching products 2021-22
